title: Scribe: migration script for typed-year IDs
problem: Existing scribe state uses the old global integer ID layout and needs to be migrated to the new per-(type, year) structure.
description: Write scripts/migrate_scribe_to_typed_year_ids.py: 1. For each existing note (active + archive), parse creation timestamp and bucket as (type, real_year). 2. Within each bucket, sort by timestamp ascending, assign seq starting at 1. Build display_id strings. 3. Move body files: <type>/<old_id>.md -> <type>/<year>/<seq>.md. Same for archive. 4. Rewrite index.jsonl files atomically. Initialize next_seq counters. 5. Write migration_id_map.json mapping old IDs to new display_ids (bare int and L-prefix spaces). 6. Reference rewriting: scan and replace old-format refs (#<digits>, #L<digits>, notes.py get <digits>) in active handoff/learning bodies, memory/*.md, core/commands/*.md, scribe/CLAUDE.md using the migration map. 7. Backup entire scribe state + affected docs before mutation (mirror scripts/repair_scribe.py pattern). 8. Support --dry-run and --force flags. 9. Test file: renumbering correctness, body file rename, migration map contents, reference rewriting, dry-run no-op, idempotence, backup snapshot.
